title: "1. Define the question: Synthetic practice"

## Your question

::: {.callout-note}
How do composition and diversity differ between Group A and Group B?
:::

These are 24 fictional samples, 12 per group, with 15 fictional features. Learn how a count table becomes evidence; these patterns are not biological discoveries.

| Location | Folder |
|---|---|
| Inputs | `data/synthetic/` |
| Outputs | `results/synthetic/` |
| Settings | `config/synthetic.tsv` |

## Decide before running

Name the sample unit, reference group and comparison group. Explain whether
you want a description, a community-level association or a feature-level
association. Keep those questions distinct.

The same seven steps carry you from question to report. Complete [setup](../../00-setup.qmd)
first. Save one short note at each step; use these notes in your report.

**Your task:** write your question in one sentence and one conclusion this
design cannot establish. Ask AI to check whether the question matches the
available sample units; you decide whether its proposed wording is justified.
